title: The Fall of a Genius
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's retreating back after being stripped of qualification was etched with hatred, and somewhere beyond the crowd, a pair of crimson eyes watched it all—Han Lie, he was finally going to make his move.

text.content: The black qi erupting from Ling Yuan's palm was like a venomous snake awakening from the abyss, carrying the stench of decay and death. Chen Ji stood in place, his robes fluttering violently in the spiritual pressure, yet the shock on his face froze into ice in an instant—he had waited for this moment far too long. 'Sect Master Uncle,' Chen Ji's voice was calm, completely unlike a waste who had just been nearly crushed to death, 'what is that in your palm?'

Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply. The black qi, though suppressed by his will, could no longer be completely hidden. He hadn't expected this waste to maintain such composed observation even at the brink of death. 'Hmph, merely some demonic qi absorbed during cultivation.' Ling Yuan coldly snorted, waving his sleeve. 'Do you still have the leisure to concern yourself with such things, you waste?' Whispers erupted in the audience seating, but Chen Ji smiled—that smile hid daggers.

dialogue.content: 'Demonic qi?' Chen Ji slowly stepped forward, each footfall crushing down on Ling Yuan's heart. 'The junior is not talented, but I have some knowledge of forbidden arts. The black qi in Sect Master Uncle's palm is not ordinary demonic qi—it is the unique mark of the ancient forbidden art 'Soul Devouring Art'. May I ask, Sect Master Uncle, where did you learn this technique that only those on the Demonic Path would practice?'

text.content: Upon these words, the entire arena erupted in uproar. Ling Yuan's expression instantly turned as dark as murky water, murder flickering in his eyes, all of which Chen Ji caught completely. 'A bunch of nonsense!' Ling Yuan roared in fury, spiritual power surging in his palm as he attempted to overwhelm Chen Ji with sheer pressure. 'A servant disciple dares to slander the Sect Master? Is this rebellion?' Chen Ji remained unmoved, instead taking another step forward, his voice ringing clear across the entire arena: 'Whether the disciple is slandering can be verified by the Law Enforcement Elder with a single examination.'

choice.prompt: The Law Enforcement Elder was already walking toward them, and Ling Yuan's killing intent became undisguised. This was indeed an ideal moment to strike while the adversary was down, but one must also consider the consequences—Ling Yuan was, after all, the former Sect Master, with deeply entrenched factional influences. How will you handle this situation?

choices.description: Since the facade has been torn away, you must nail Ling Yuan to the pillar of eternal shame. Expose more evidence publicly, ensuring he can never翻身.
choices.visible_reward: Ling Yuan's reputation is ruined beyond any chance of comeback
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may act desperately and strike on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji retrieved a jade slip from his sleeve—that was the spiritual residual traces he had copied using the Tianji Record's power when Ling Yuan released the forbidden art. As the slip's image projected into the air, everyone's expression changed. That was clearly the scene of Ling Yuan施展' Soul Devouring Art', black qi coiling around, shocking to the eye.

choices.description: Know when to stop. Ling Yuan has already been exposed; pressing further might only drive him to desperation. Spare his life—there may still be use for him later.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan will have room to breathe
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, avoid making too many enemies
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan will think you weak and easy to bully

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, handing the jade slip to the Law Enforcement Elder: 'The disciple merely reported what was observed. Everything shall be judged by the elders.' These words were flawless, simultaneously demonstrating his innocence while passing the烫手山芋 to the Law Enforcement Elder. A flicker of surprise crossed Ling Yuan's eyes—since when had thistrash become so formidable?

choices.description: Put on a magnanimous front, publicly excuse Ling Yuan. This contrast will let everyone see Ling Yuan's despicable nature.
choices.visible_cost: May appear too weak, potentially lowering your prestige
choices.visible_reward: Public opinion will overwhelmingly support you
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may not necessarily be grateful

text.content: Chen Ji modestly bowed, his voice carrying恰到好处的 fear: 'The disciple may have been mistaken. Sect Master Uncle's cultivation is supreme—how could he possibly practice demonic forbidden arts...' Before he could finish, the Law Enforcement Elder had already seized Ling Yuan's wrist. A detection technique flared—the black qi had nowhere to hide. 'Ling Yuan! Do you have anything to say!'

The image recorded in the jade slip was unmistakably clear, the scene of Ling Yuan施展 forbidden arts frozen in mid-air. The Law Enforcement Elder's expression turned iron-blue. A technique struck Ling Yuan, immobilizing him on the spot. 'Ling Yuan! Explain yourself immediately!' Ling Yuan's lips trembled, attempting to argue, but found all his excuses hollow and powerless. The uproar in the audience grew louder and louder, those formerly respectful gazes now filled with contempt and horror.

dialogue.content: 'This is a frame-up!' Ling Yuan howled, madness flickering in his eyes. 'You must have colluded with outsiders, deliberately framing me! Law Enforcement Elder, do not listen to a mere servant's slander!' Chen Ji watched him struggle quietly, a cold smile curling at his lips—the dying's lament is often the most beautiful melody.

text.content: The Law Enforcement Elder's gaze swept between Ling Yuan and Chen Ji before finally settling on the jade slip. He reached out, drawing the slip into his palm for careful examination. His expression grew increasingly grave. 'This spiritual energy signature... is indeed Ling Yuan's beyond doubt.' Ling Yuan shuddered violently, cold sweat dripping down his forehead. He had never imagined his carefully hidden trump card would be exposed publicly by atrash.

'Lingu Yuan!' The Law Enforcement Elder's voice was cold as freezing ice. 'Sect rules explicitly forbid practicing demonic forbidden arts. As the sect leader, you knowingly violated the law—your crime is doubled! Seize him! Strip all positions and titles, confine to the sect prison, awaiting judgment!' Ling Yuan was seized by two law enforcement disciples, his formerly lofty posture completely obliterated. He stared fixedly back at Chen Ji, the hatred in his eyes almost wanting to devour Chen Ji alive.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji—' Ling Yuan's voice came from hell itself as he was dragged away. 'Your heart is truly cruel! Today's humiliation, I shall remember in my heart! As long as I draw one more breath, I will make you thistrash pay the price!' Chen Ji merely modestly clasped his hands, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'The disciple respectfully escorts Sect Master Uncle. May Sect Master Uncle reflect well in the sect prison, and soon recognize your wrongs.' These words, to Ling Yuan's ears, were no different from the most vicious curse.

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan was taken away, but his parting vow clearly signaled: this matter will never end here. How will you conduct yourself next?

choices.description: Maintain thetrash persona, treating everyone with utmost respect. Let everyone think you simply got lucky, not that you actually possess ability.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to establish authority
choices.visible_reward: More people will lower their guard against you
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may become even more suspicious of you

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his head, retreating into the crowd, his shoulders trembling slightly as if terrified. The surrounding disciples cast various gazes—some sympathetic, some mocking, most gloating. Yet only a very few noticed: beneath those lowered eyelids, his眸光 was as calm as an ancient well in a deep pool, not a single ripple.

choices.description: Since you've already revealed part of your strength, might as well display it openly. Let those petty individuals know you're not to be bullied.
choices.visible_reward: Reputation will soar greatly, making enemies wary
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's underlying faction will regard you as a thorn in their eye

text.content: Chen Ji straightened his spine, his gaze sweeping across those disciples who had once bullied him, a meaningful smile curling at his lips. 'Fellow brothers and sisters, please give me your guidance in the future.' The words were polite, but theedge in his eyes sent chills down everyone's spine—thistrash, it seems, is different now.

The Law Enforcement Elder cleared his throat, his voice echoing across the silent plaza: 'Regarding Ling Yuan's use of forbidden arts, evidence is conclusive. Today's match, Chen Ji is victorious, advancing directly to the finals!' Complete silence first fell over the crowd, then erupted into hushed discussions. Those who had been waiting to see Chen Ji's downfall now felt their faces burn as if slapped. Yet Chen Ji merely stood calmly at the scene, as if this victory had nothing to do with him.

In the crowd, Su Qingyao's gaze was like a sharp blade, tightly locked on Chen Ji. Thistrash, with his seamless series of operations—from discovering forbidden art traces to preserving evidence, to public exposure, timing perfect to the millisecond—how could atrash possibly do this? Her heart rang alarm bells, her suspicions toward Chen Ji deepening yet again. Chen Ji seemed to sense something, turning to meet her gaze, then looked away, a faint, inexplicable smile hanging at the corner of his lips.

Meanwhile, in the highest VIP seating of the plaza, a pair of crimson eyes peered through the crowd, tightly watching Chen Ji. Han Lie clenched his fists, knuckles cracking. 'Interesting...' His voice was low as thunder. 'Thistrash is far more intriguing than I imagined. Since that fool Ling Yuan is already finished, let me personally meet you.' His eyes burned with炽热 battle intent—he couldn't wait to tear this所谓的trash to shreds in the finals.

The match concluded. Chen Ji followed the dispersing crowd. His pace remained slow, his expression humble, as if nothing that happened today concerned him at all.
